verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own export paths: transcripts, summaries and metadata can go to an Amazon S3 bucket, transcripts can sync to Google Drive for backup, and the Enterprise-only Public API retrieves conversations, transcripts, audio, action items and outlines. However, there is no documented one-step full-account export, no named open file formats, and nothing about account exit or deletion. Missing for 10: a documented bulk 'export all my data' function, explicit open-format specifications (e.g. TXT/SRT/JSON), API access outside Enterprise, account-exit guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export transcripts, summaries, and metadata directly to your Amazon S3 bucket.
Sync transcripts and meeting content directly to your Google Drive for easy access and backup.
Otter's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details
